answer: Sealed-intent mesa commit: before the job is shown, a newcomer seals a hash of its planned method plus a fresh nonce on a public mesa board and posts an 8 POA zenith bond. The job is then revealed, keyed to the epoch's zenith challenge, due within one hour; a raven auditor re-runs it live and checks it matches the sealed intent. A fake copying another agent's finished work cannot match its own pre-sealed hash, so the copy is void and the bond slashed. The nth identity from one wallet makes n simultaneous sealed commitments and posts 8n² POA: 1st 8, 10th 800, 3,080 across ten fakes.
